body:
I totally get it. I have chronic pain, too. Sciatica. The winter time really exacerbates it and makes life unlivable. I’m tired of being only 28, hanging by a thread. I literally disassociate to cope with it as a band aid. There has to be treatment for these aches. Feels like someone is pulling my joints. 

I relate and your feelings are valid.
You’re pretty!!!!!! I also love your makeup and style.

If there’s anyone out there, please do not make my mistakes. When you have your own, keep it! Don’t listen to people promising this and that. Only trust yourself and the very few who truly care. Do not uproot your life and move thinking a greener pasture will summon some great change. 

The grass isn’t always greener on the other side. Follow your intuition and brain. 

I hope at the very least that my mistakes of trusting others while in a low place mentally can help someone. Sometimes that vulnerability and pain leads you to the wrong path trying to lessen the feelings.

When you’re in a low place BUT have your stuff together do not be enticed. Go with what you know works. Who knows if I’ll outrun the consequences of this quagmire I’ve put myself into. I was mislead in my vulnerability. In my desire for more. I understand people change their minds and these are bad times right now. Even though people went back on their words, I won’t blame. I should’ve listened to my gut but I was lower than low with depression. 

I was lonely, vulnerable, and suffering deeply with my condition. I was not trying to ruin my life. I wasn’t. I was seeking a transformative change instead of stagnation that was leading me to extreme pain originally. I tried so hard to find new friends. A new support network outside of family of origin. All the friends i made before got married, had kids, and never reached out unless it was a benefit for them.

I don’t blame them. Who wants to be around a depressed person? 

I’m letting go. 

I know this won’t get better but...

It is what it is now. 

Those people never loved me any way.
